analysis.title: Tech, Gold, and Fed Speak - GS Daily Monitor
key_insights: Tech led US equities higher after NVDA reported an EPS beat and raised its CY27 sales growth guide to 75%.
Gold fell below $3,800 after further Fed officials' comments pointing to more rate hikes.
Fed's Musalem said the US economy would likely need several interest-rate increases before spring.
UK inflation rose to its highest level in a year, driven by higher energy bills and motor fuel costs.
Bank Indonesia raised rates by 25bp, a hawkish surprise, and added DNDF, SRBI and FX intervention measures.
KDI's 2027 South Korea growth forecast of +3.9% is above the IMF's estimate.
The EU proposed a new EUR45 billion loan for Ukraine to fund civilian services and military needs.
US forces attacked a missile launch site on Qeshm Island with no casualties reported.
A Saudi-led coalition carried out a major operation against the Houthis, destroying 60 military targets.
earnings_insights: NVDA reported an EPS beat (the note gives no EPS figure or estimate) and raised its CY27 sales growth guide to 75%. The 75% is company guidance, not a consensus figure.

macro_indicators.reading: Highest level in a year (no figure given)
macro_indicators.interpretation: Driven by a surge in energy bills and motor fuel costs.
A hawkish surprise, accompanied by DNDF, SRBI and FX intervention measures.

macro_indicators.reading: Several interest-rate increases needed before spring
macro_indicators.interpretation: Hawkish Fed commentary was tied to the drop in gold.

risk_factors: Further Fed rate hikes, as signaled by officials' comments.
Escalation in the Middle East (Qeshm Island strike, Houthi operation).
Energy and motor fuel cost pass-through into UK inflation.
geopolitical: US forces attacked a missile launch site on Qeshm Island, with no casualties reported.
A coalition in Saudi Arabia carried out a major operation against the Houthis, destroying 60 military targets.
The EU proposed a new EUR45 billion loan for Ukraine.
